title: The Dog Night, 2018
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Nineteen years. The recycling bin. The outline. The box. The sign: six dark.

panels.composition: Behind the Lanes. The rust outline. WOOD standing in it. BARNABY II sitting in it. The blue bin behind.

panels.composition: The porch. The box. The pup in it. Wood on the step.
